newsitem.title: GERMANY: No M3 comment from Buba yet, 2nd statement possible.
newsitem.headline: No M3 comment from Buba yet, 2nd statement possible.

text.p: The Bundesbank made no comment on its review of its M3 money supply target in an initial statement on interest rates, but a spokesman said a second statement on the M3 review was possible.
"I can't say whether there will be a second statement. There has been in recent years," the spokesman said.
The central bank has often in the recent past issued its interest rate decision separately from statements on any other discussions at its meeting.
